rows.title: Agent rows above the prompt
rows.description: auto: one row per running agent above the prompt only while the agents pane is not showing (closed, or the terminal is too narrow to seat it), so nothing repeats the pane. off: never draw the rows. always: draw them even while the pane is open, which also covers the engine's diff panel taking the pane's seat.
